---
name: Missed or wrong detection
about: Personal data that was not found, or text that was removed but is not personal data
---

> **Never paste real personal data**: no real names, emails, phone numbers, addresses or customer feedback, and no real files. Use an invented example with the same pattern (for example `anna.example@example.com` or `+43 664 0000000`). A security or privacy problem goes in a [private report](https://github.com/akojif/painfold/security/advisories/new), not here.

## The pattern

What the value looks like, in words (for example "Austrian mobile number with a space after the area code", or "name after 'Grüße,' at the end of a sentence").

## Invented example

Write the sentence or value with invented data in the same format, for example `+43 664 0000000` instead of a real number.

## What should have happened

- [ ] It should have been removed (missed)
- [ ] It should have been kept (false alarm)

## Data type (email, phone, IBAN, name, place, …)

## Language of the text

- [ ] German
- [ ] English
